description: Start a historical sales backfill from QuickBooks Online: a durable background import of Invoice and SalesReceipt documents from QBO into Spark's sales graph. Seeds customers, items, and demand velocity so forecasting works immediately. USD only; 36-month window. Idempotent — returns the existing run if one is active or completed. Blocked when the tenant has a connected commerce channel (Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, Square, Meta) or retained commerce sales history, because QBO sales are typically accounting mirrors and cannot be safely deduplicated without source lineage. Poll progress via get_integration_status (provider 'qbo'). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token with write access.
name: trigger_qbo_sales_backfill
title: Start QuickBooks Sales Backfill
